findings.explanation: Editorial, human technical, rights and operational admission decisions are separately recorded. Template completion cannot authorize its own source use.
Copyright Office explains case-specific four-factor review and no fixed amount/percentage guarantee. Candidate avoids claiming that paraphrase itself clears rights.
CC BY 4.0 legal code supports the limited scope, attribution/change notices, downstream restrictions and trademark exclusion; the deed is identified as a summary.
A homepage link is not presented as evidence that a decisive paragraph was inspected; the original counterexample either requires authorized access or reframing.
No fact-specific fair-use or comprehensive rights determination is supplied, and no human professional or database approval is created.
